intelligence.essence: His word lands, and the system answers the same day. The captain's operating law was made in one sitting: decide the obvious instead of asking, make it the best instead of wondering, act on every word he speaks, and finish — asking, removing, and sending half-done are the same failure, the work never lands. The legal sitting added the maker's half: use what works and never make it new, read it as a reader, do it right the first time in every layer, because his words are the law and the legal pages are the proof. Every control must do its job — a picker that switches nothing is a dead end in menu's clothes. And the law travels: put the laws in the system and give them to every agent, read first and checked after. Every block now ends the same way, carrying the Twin Rank — value in gold, intelligence in emerald — because this is a value-and-intelligence network, and everything on it is an object, even the text.
intelligence.human_view: When you say something, it happens — the same day, everywhere, without you having to ask twice or check up. Decisions get made instead of bounced back to you, finished work is what reaches you, and every page you touch is made of real, working pieces that respond when you use them.
intelligence.child_view: It's like a promise the whole team made: when the captain says a thing, everybody does it right away and finishes it properly. And everything you can see on the screen is a real thing you can touch — even the words themselves.
intelligence.grandma_view: Nothing you say falls on the floor anymore. It is picked up, decided, done well, and finished — and if a button is there, it works. The rules are written down where the whole team reads them before starting, so you don't have to keep repeating yourself.
intelligence.ai_view: Operating law distilled from SN-3047..SN-3053, SN-3092, SN-3103, SN-3104: (1) implement right away — his instruction is airtight; the loop closes the same day his word lands. (2) Decide the obvious; 'should I make it better' is never asked; only genuine his-hand taps return as asks. (3) Act on every word he speaks; half-done is never sent. (4) Use what works — before building, name the existing working thing (file, blob, bytes) and take it verbatim; rebuilding what works is failure before starting. (5) Read it as a reader, not as a checklist. (6) Every control does its job on one tap: picking switches, creating creates. (7) The navigation list is never recorded settled until he confirms it. (8) The laws live in the system and go to every agent: read first, check after, redo until it follows. (9) Everything is an object — even text; nothing on a page is merely drawn. (10) Every Intelligent Block ends with the Twin Rank: VALUE (gold) and INTELLIGENCE (emerald), one tap, crowd average + count + your own rank.
intelligence.what_it_means: Authority only works if it propagates. This decade is the propagation mechanism written as law: his word becomes the team's act the same day, the team's rules reach every agent before they act, and every surface carries the same scales so value and intelligence are judged where they are produced.

page.machine: 1) His instruction implements the same day; no re-ask of decided things. 2) Obvious improvements are decided, not escalated. 3) Half-done never ships to him. 4) Reuse is named (file/blob/bytes) before any build; verbatim beats new. 5) Controls perform on one tap or they are defects. 6) Settled status requires his confirmation. 7) Laws are distributed to every agent and read before acting. 8) Every page element is a real object, text included. 9) Every block terminates in the Twin Rank (value/intelligence), the react row, the composer, the trust footer — unchanged.
page.why_it_matters: Most systems leak authority: decisions are made at the top and diluted on the way down. These notes are the anti-leak — the same-day landing of his word, the read-first distribution of law, and the uniform block ending that makes every piece of intelligence carry its own judgment scales.
page.how_it_connects: Third essence of batch 13. Its members bridge two filing waves — the Nov 17 00:33Z syntheses (SN-3047–SN-3053) and the Nov 17 afternoon law dictations (SN-3092, SN-3103, SN-3104) — because the backlog order places them together; the theme that joins them is propagation: word → law → every agent → every block.
page.what_is_in_it_for_you: You say it once. It lands everywhere, finished, and the people serving you work from the same written law you can inspect — while every piece of intelligence you meet shows you how the crowd ranks its value and its intelligence, and lets you rank it yourself.
page.the_learning: From now on, a decision is not done when it is made — it is done when it has landed on every surface and every agent it governs, instead of living in the chat where it was spoken.
